author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Tyler Mahle (hamstring) to make rehab start Sunday
desc: Tyler Mahle is scheduled to make a rehab start with Triple-A Sacramento on Sunday.
impact: Mahle was able to throw a simulated game on June 9 without any issues and is set to begin a minor league rehab assignment on Sunday. It remains unclear how many starts he will need before being activated from the injured list.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Freddy Fermin exits Saturday with head injury
desc: Freddy Fermin exited during the sixth inning of Saturday's 9-3 win over the Baltimore Orioles due to a head injury.
impact: Fermin was hit by a warmup pitch from Yuki Matsui before the start of the bottom of the sixth inning. San Diego Padres manager Craig Stammen said the team will be cautious with Fermin, as he was previously removed from an April 15 game after being struck in the catcher's mask. He will be evaluated for a concussion.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Konnor Griffin (forearm) to begin rehab assignment Sunday
desc: Konnor Griffin is scheduled to begin a minor league rehab assignment on Sunday.
impact: Griffin landed on the 10-day injured list on May 31 due to a right forearm strain. He began throwing on June 7 and has progressed quickly through his throwing program. He is set to begin a rehab assignment Sunday, and fantasy managers can expect him to return before the end of the month.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Adam Frazier (elbow) takes batting practice Saturday
desc: Adam Frazier has participated in light baseball activities and took batting practice on the field Friday and Saturday.
impact: Frazier was placed on the 10-day injured list on June 8 due to right elbow inflammation. The injury is not considered serious, and he has already progressed to hitting. He is expected to rejoin the Los Angeles Angels before the end of June.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Vaughn Grissom (oblique) takes batting practice Saturday
desc: Vaughn Grissom took batting practice on the field Saturday.
impact: Grissom recently began participating in light baseball activities and has progressed to taking batting practice on Saturday. While a timeline for activation remains unclear, he has made encouraging progress since suffering a left oblique strain on June 4.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Cole Ragans (elbow) suffers setback
desc: Cole Ragans had his throwing session cut short on Friday due to discomfort and is scheduled to undergo further testing.
impact: Ragans threw a 23-pitch bullpen session on Wednesday but woke up with discomfort on Friday, which ultimately cut his throwing session short. He will undergo testing to determine the next steps.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Vinnie Pasquantino suffers hand/hamate injury Saturday
desc: Vinnie Pasquantino exited during the fifth inning of Saturday's 8-7 loss to the Houston Astros due to a right hand/hamate injury.
impact: Pasquantino showed discomfort after making contact with the ball in the fifth inning. Kansas City Royals manager Matt Quatraro said the expectation is that Pasquantino will land on the injured list. However, the severity of the injury will become clearer once he undergoes further testing on Sunday.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Matthew Boyd (knee) to throw bullpen early next week
desc: Matthew Boyd is scheduled to throw a bullpen session early next week.
impact: Boyd was expected to return from the injured list this weekend, but those plans were put on hold after he experienced soreness during a bullpen session on Tuesday. He was able long toss on Friday without any issues and is scheduled to throw a bullpen session early next week. While the latest update is encouraging, his timeline remains uncertain following the setback.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Seiya Suzuki exits Saturday with knee injury
desc: Seiya Suzuki exited during the fourth inning of Saturday's 6-1 victory over the San Francisco Giants due to right knee discomfort.
impact: Suzuki suffered the injury after landing awkwardly on a missed catch attempt in the outfield and was removed from the game following an evaluation by the training staff. It's a situation fantasy managers will want to monitor closely, especially since he opened the season on the injured list with a right knee injury sustained during the World Baseball Classic while playing for Team Japan. Suzuki said Saturday's incident produced a similar sensation, though he noted the discomfort was not as severe this time around. He can be considered day-to-day for now, with the Chicago Cubs expected to evaluate him again on Sunday before determining his availability for the series finale.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Michael Helman (hand) suffers multiple fractures Saturday
desc: Michael Helman suffered multiple fractures in his right hand when he was hit by a pitch in Saturday's 6-3 loss to the Boston Red Sox.
impact: Helman was struck on the right hand by a 99.5 mph sinker from Tyson Guerrero in the eighth inning. Although he remained in the game to run the bases, he was replaced defensively in the bottom half of the frame. He is scheduled to undergo additional testing on Sunday, but fantasy managers should prepare for an extended absence.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Griffin Jax handed loss despite no earned runs allowed
desc: Griffin Jax allowed one unearned run on five hits and did not issue a walk while striking out five over five innings in Saturday's 8-0 loss to the Los Angeles Angels.
impact: After surrendering six earned runs to the Detroit Tigers on June 1, Jax has bounced back by not allowing an earned run in either of his last two starts. Despite that rough outing, he owns a 3.86 ERA and 1.29 WHIP with 14 strikeouts across 14 innings in June. He is currently lined up to make his next start on Friday against the Washington Nationals.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Ronel Blanco (elbow) set to begin rehab assignment
desc: Ronel Blanco threw 40 pitches in a simulated game on Saturday and is set to begin a rehab assignment in the Florida Complex League next week.
impact: Blanco is entering the final stages of his recovery from Tommy John surgery with an internal brace, which he underwent in June 2025. He will still need multiple rehab appearances to continue building up his workload before being activated from the injured list. As a result, fantasy managers should not expect him back in the majors until the second half of the season.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Cristian Javier (shoulder) to make third rehab start Sunday
desc: Cristian Javier is scheduled to make his third minor league rehab start on Sunday with Triple-A Sugar Land.
impact: Javier has made two rehab starts while recovering from a Grade 2 right shoulder strain, posting a 4.91 ERA and 1.09 WHIP with five strikeouts across 3.2 innings. He will likely require at least one more rehab outing after Sunday as he continues to build up his pitch count before returning to the Houston Astros' rotation.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Colt Emerson blasts long ball Saturday
desc: Colt Emerson went 1-for-4 with a home run in the Mariners 8-3 loss on Saturday against the Nationals.
impact: Emerson went yard for the second straight game this weekend. He is slashing .233/.309/.575 across 81 plate appearances with six home runs to begin his career.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Luis Castillo takes loss Saturday
desc: Luis Castillo allowed five runs (two earned) on seven hits over 5 2/3 innings with four strikeouts and two walks in a loss on Saturday against the Nationals.
impact: Castillo was a little unlucky in the loss as a pair of errors led to three of the runs he allowed being unearned. He'll remain in a six-man rotation heading into a start against the Red Sox.
